question: Bitrise is named in the u04 scope as a provider to document in ci-cd-runners, but it is already held as compute/bitrise (mobile CI) and storage/bitrise-artifacts. why: The deduplication rule forbids a duplicate record, and Bitrise already has two records in the corpus; the integrator must decide the cross-topic relationship.
